notes.title: Demo v1.1 Release
notes.notes:
This update fixes an issue where sometimes players would get stuck after hitting a wall, not being able to move or even take any damage. Not good! It's fixed now, and shouldn't happen again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799985/ce2b9fe10dbd36095c30b4d8523e6bf522615561.gif


Full list of changes:

- Player will no longer sometimes get stuck after bumping into walls or other objects
- Player's hitpoints will now show the correct value after using a Quick Repair card
